Fill completely or cancel immediately (FOK) requires the entire limit order to fill immediately after submission. Otherwise, the whole order is cancelled with no partial fill and does not remain in the order book.
"Order quantity: 10 contracts Immediately available quantity: 10 contracts or more Result: The entire order fills immediately"
"Order quantity: 10 contracts Immediately available quantity: 6 contracts Result: The entire order is cancelled; no 6-contract partial fill"

An OKX iceberg order splits a large order into smaller limit orders and submits them in batches according to the amount per order and orders per batch, reducing the market impact of a large order. You can set a pending order price limit and start it immediately, at a specified price, or by RSI.

"Total amount: 10,000 DOGE Amount per order: 1,000 DOGE; orders per batch: 2 Start method: Immediate Execution condition: OKX submits up to 2 small limit orders per batch until the total amount is completed"

"Total amount: 10,000 DOGE Trigger price: 0.080 USDT; pending order price limit: 0.082 USDT Start method: Price Execution condition: The strategy starts when the market reaches the trigger price and places orders within the configured price limit"
Fill immediately and cancel remaining (IOC) immediately fills the available quantity and cancels any unfilled remainder. It does not remain in the order book.
"Order quantity: 10 contracts Immediately available quantity: 10 contracts or more Result: The entire order fills immediately"
"Order quantity: 10 contracts Immediately available quantity: 6 contracts Result: 6 contracts fill immediately and the remaining 4 are cancelled"

An ordinary order refers to an order to buy or sell at a specified price or better. When the specified price is the market price, it is a market order.

"Current market price: 100 Buy limit: 120 Execution conditions: Transaction at price around 100, not 120, to ensure better price execution"

"Current market price: 100 Sell limit: 80 Execution condition: Trade at around price 100, not 80, to ensure better price execution"

Take Profit / Stop Loss is a conditional order with a preset trigger price and execution method. After submission, the exchange holds the order and executes it at the configured market or limit price when the trigger price is reached.
"Current market price: 100 Sell take-profit trigger: 120 Execution condition: When the market price rises to 120, sell at the configured market or limit price"
"Current market price: 100 Sell stop-loss trigger: 90 Execution condition: When the market price falls to 90, sell at the configured market or limit price"

Planned order is an AI-developed trigger order tool. The order is sent to the exchange only after the latest price reaches the trigger price, which helps avoid placing the order in advance on the exchange.

"Current market price: 1600 Target price: 2800; take-profit and stop-loss prices: 2600, 3000 Execution condition: When the market price rises from 1600 to 2800, the corresponding limit or market order will be placed.
